title: Filipino Roasted Quinoa Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious quinoa bowl made with roasted chicken and vegetables, inspired by Filipino cuisine.
instructions: Rinse the quinoa and cook according to package instructions.
Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
In a large bowl, toss the mixed vegetables with coconut oil, soy sauce, and lime juice.
Roast the chicken in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
Roast the vegetables in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until tender.
Fluff the cooked quinoa with a fork.
To assemble the dish, place the cooked quinoa in a bowl, top with roasted chicken and vegetables.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
